question:
**Find the part of the sentence that contains an error: **

That the report failed to address the root causes (1)/ of the community unrest were surprising (2)/ given the exhaustive data (3)/ compiled over several months. (4)
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The error lies in **part (2)** of the sentence due to incorrect **subject-verb agreement**.
 
• The subject of the sentence is the entire noun clause: "**That the report failed to address the root causes of the community unrest**."
 
• When a noun clause acts as the subject of a sentence, it is treated as a **singular unit**.
 
• The plural verb "**were**" must be replaced by the singular verb "**was**" to match the singular subject.

Therefore, the correct answer is **2**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"That the report failed to address the root causes of the community unrest **was** surprising given the exhaustive data compiled over several months."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **(1): "That the report failed to address the root causes"** – This is the beginning of the noun clause and is grammatically sound.
 
• **(3): "given the exhaustive data"** – This part correctly introduces the reason or evidence for the surprise.
 
• **(4): "compiled over several months."** – This uses a past participle phrase correctly to modify the noun "data."
